text: So what breaks the balance? The control depends on genes, and genes are lengths of DNA. A mutation is a change in the DNA sequence. One typical cause is ultraviolet radiation in sunlight: it reaches the cells of your skin and can cause mutations in them. Many such changes land nowhere near a gene that controls division. A change in a division-control gene can disrupt its function. Suppose that happens here: this cell loses control of its cell cycle and divides repeatedly when it should not.
